Is  the crampingtex the definitive measure of missingness ->
1. Chose a crampingtex 
2. extract
3. data clean 
4. pivotwider
5. from there compare the missingness across words
    is the missingness values the same
    are the same columns empty 
    
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("duckdb")
library("dplyr")
library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(stringr, tidyverse, gtsummary, ggplot2, GGally, vtable, grid, gridExtra, diffdf, corrplot, broom, purrr, varhandle)
source("replace_chunk.R")
peter_file <- "C:/Users/samake/OneDrive - Oregon Health & Science University/AD and DS Project/csand_data.duckdb/csand_data.duckdb"
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))
nlp_table<-tbl(con, "visits_nlp_tier1_pivoted_unpacked")
```

#1. Chose a crampingtex -> CmaRpaAorMbiPauIidNorGagTgfErsXwxSs1 / 2. extract
```{r}
cramp_chosen <- nlp_table %>%   
  filter(crampingtexs.data =="CmaRpaAorMbiPauIidNorGagTgfErsXwxSs1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  collect()
  
```
# 3. data clean 
```{r}
cramp_clean <- cramp_chosen %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(c(crampingtexs.data, visit_id, value , feature.name))
```

```{r}
cramp_clean <- cramp_clean %>%  mutate(new_name =  paste(feature.name, crampingtexs.data, sep ="_" )) %>% 
  arrange(desc(crampingtexs.data))
```

```{r}
## remove crampingtexs
cramp_cleaned <- cramp_clean%>% 
  select(-c(crampingtexs.data, feature.name))
```

# 4. pivotwider
```{r}
### new dataframe 
wide_cramp <- cramp_cleaned %>% pivot_wider( id_cols =  c(visit_id ),
                                         names_from = new_name,
                                         values_from = value)
```
#5. from there compare the missingness across words theres missingness however is it the same row/s thats causing missingness
```{r}
colSums(is.na(wide_cramp) 
        ) 
```


```{r}
 rowSums(is.na(wide_cramp)) 
```

#6 ignore the prenious stuff  how many grouping variables are there in theory 
```{r}
cramp_to_count <- nlp_table %>%   
  #filter(crampingtexs.data =="CmaRpaAorMbiPauIidNorGagTgfErsXwxSs1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r}
cramp_to_count %>% 
  group_by(crampingtexs.data) %>% 
  summarise(unique_feat = n_distinct(feature.name, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(unique_feat))
```

```{r}
unique(cramp_to_count$feature.name, na.rm = TRUE)
```
